verdict.rationale: ADK ships an official `adk` CLI with documented commands to run agents (`adk run`), launch the web UI (`adk web`), evaluate (`adk eval`), and deploy to Docker or Cloud Run (`adk deploy`). The docs also describe an Agents CLI for use from AI-enabled developer environments to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy. Missing for 10: a comprehensive first-party CLI reference covering all commands and flags, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.
Migrate existing agents and workflows to ADK with Agents CLI.
